items.name: loop
items.description: A GitHub-native operating protocol for planners, workers, reviewers, testers, fixers, mergers, janitors, an improver that tunes the loop on measured results, and an orchestrator that dispatches them.

items.name: swarm
items.description: Rallypoint Swarm: shared memory in your own Supabase, self-picking roles, a referee (score, checks or review), retros, buried ideas, concepts, genesis and a conductor loop. Install after loop.

items.name: swarm-ui
items.description: The swarm UI route scaffold, installed into an existing Next.js App Router app (the UI is the product): Progress, News, Targets, Results, Versions, Ideas buried, Fleet, Sessions, Rallypoint, Board, Messages, How it works, Protocol, Concepts, Skills. Read-only. Generates a project-owned app/swarm/swarm.config.ts.

items.name: swarm-dashboard
items.description: The same swarm UI scaffold as a standalone Next.js app in swarm-ui/, for projects without a Next.js app or that keep the dashboard separate. Read-only. Generates a project-owned swarm-ui/app/swarm/swarm.config.ts.
